text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government, businessmen and workers' union officials to hold tripartite talks on April 15 to tackle social issues.
- Seventeen bus passengers killed in the southern town of Sfid, in the western province of Saida.
- Home-made bomb kills one person and wounds 13 in Boufarik, south of Algiers.
- "One terrorist" confesses killing Abdelhak Benhamouda, leader of the main workers'union.
- Bomb kills two in Boufarik. Haidresser killed in Algiers.
